page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8te.32xlarge is an accelerated bare-metal instance designed for high-density computing and hardware-accelerated processing. The system is driven by 128 dedicated virtual cores based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6462C processor clocked at 3.3 GHz. Paired with this host processor is 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing an allocation of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by an array of 8 NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture GPUs containing an aggregate of 384 GB of VRAM.

Network connectivity features a high-throughput baseline bandwidth of 170 Gbps managed over a KVM hypervisor. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external or networked block storage attachments for persistent system and application volumes. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating explicit networking configuration for external routing.

From a resource and architectural perspective, ecs.ebmgn8te.32xlarge represents a high capital-density tier. It bundles massive parallel graphics computation, extensive system RAM, and high-bandwidth interconnects within a single host. The lack of local storage requires network storage provisioning, which introduces potential I/O latency tradeoffs that must be managed over the 170 Gbps network fabric. This platform is aligned with large-scale deep learning training, massive parallel AI model inference, high-performance computing simulations, rendering pipelines, and data-intensive visual computing workflows.

It includes no bundled local storage volumes and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring reliance on attached network storage solutions and auxiliary network routing. The dense pairing of massive GPU memory, multi-core processing power, and elevated network throughput targets resource-intensive workloads such as large-scale artificial intelligence model training, high-throughput model inference, distributed graphics rendering, scientific simulations, and heavy computational data processing.
